sources.title: Toxic: Hate speech triage on device | Desert Ant Labs
sources.snippet: Nothing you can run on a device catches hate speech better, and neither does the biggest model built for the job, which wants a 16 GB GPU. On Multilingual HateCheck, a public suite of hand-written examples, Toxic gets about 85 out of 100 across the seven EU languages, where Mistral's Shieldstral gets 79 and the guard models sized for a phone get 65.
